verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents filtering findings by severity or confidence, and never documents severity- or confidence-based pipeline or merge gates. The closest item is Duo false-positive detection, which produces confidence scores with explanations. That is an adjacent assessment feature, not a filter or gate. Secret push protection blocks on any detected secret, with no severity or confidence threshold.

support.subject: As a developer, I can filter and gate on findings by severity or confidence so low-value noise does not block builds
